After Four Mod successfully exchanged phones with Faye Fang Kaew It's time to change the name of AirDrop!

But no matter how I think about it, I still haven't come up with a name that catches my eye. So I had to ask the crazy people to come and help think of one thing. ><

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 2
episodes.overview: When the year ends, it's time for Spotify Wrapped to come visit🎶 Four Mod wondered if among the 5 songs that P'Chian listened to the most this year. Are there any songs that you listen to when you're together with him?🤔🤷‍♂️

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 3
episodes.overview: Chian goes to an agreement with Bua that they will exchange gifts on Christmas Day. But Chian couldn't think of anything good to give, so he got Four Mod to help him think like that?!

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 4
episodes.overview: After being reckless and not daring to confess his love to Four Mod, Baabin chose to quietly tell Fourmod on his secret Twitter account. However, one of his followers did not want the matter to end here.

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 5
episodes.overview: Bua couldn't record a new TikTok clip because his phone was full. When she was about to delete the old clips she had recorded with Chian, he felt regretful. So, Bua decided to leave the clips with Baabin, but Baabin refused to accept them.

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 6
episodes.overview: During the time that Chian was blocked by Four Mod on all social media channels, he tried not to interfere in Four Mod's life. He only posted pictures on his fake Instagram account when he missed him.

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP.7 part 1
episodes.overview: After changing his status to having a boyfriend, Baabin had to deal with a new feeling that arose, which was jealousy. But it might have been a bit too much, to the point that he felt jealous of Bua even with the people who commented on Bua's Tiktok channel.

episodes.name: charging GEL [Side Story] EP.7 part 2
episodes.overview: Chian started wanting to show off his boyfriend on social media like everyone else. But this Green Flag guy's life was never easy when his boyfriend was the number 1 person in Siam Square when it came to taking pictures.

reviews.author: Dominic Kebre
reviews.content:
“Gelboys“ is the coming-of-age and coming-out story of four boys, Fou4Mod (New Chayapak), Chian (Pide Monthapoom), Bua (Leon Zech), and Baabin (PJ Mahidol). Longtime friendships are in jeopardy when the boys experience their first same-sex love, and although they at first come across superficial with their obsession to decorating their fingernails and online chats, deep down they are vulnerable, sensitive kids trying to find their place in life. The protagonists are no wealthy kids or princes, but average, modern boys, who use the skytrain instead of fancy cars.

No other Thai director is able to describe this crucial time in gay boys’ lives as beautifully, using a language of pictures so vivid, as Boss Naruebet (“I Told Sunset About You“), who guides his lead actors to perform brilliantly. In my opinion, the cinematography is the best in any Thai series of the year, too. This is a masterpiece in every respect, once you get used to boys having their fingernails done.
